rows.note: Use this when the news correspondent is stationed overseas or away from the main newsroom.

example.english: Our overseas correspondent sends reports back from Tokyo every day.
example.traditional: 我哋個駐外記者喺東京每日報料返嚟。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 go3 zyu3 ngoi6 gei3 ze2 hai2 dung1 ging1 mui5 jat6 bou3 liu6 faan1 lei4

rows.note: Use this for a professional correspondent who sends written reports to a news organization, including one based elsewhere.

example.english: This overseas correspondent edits the interview material before sending it back to the newspaper.
example.traditional: 呢位駐外通訊員要將採訪內容編輯好先寄返報社。
example.jyutping: ni1 wai6 zyu3 ngoi6 tung1 seon3 jyun4 jiu3 zoeng1 coi2 fong2 noi6 jung4 pin1 cap1 hou2 sin1 gei3 faan1 bou3 se5

rows.note: Use this for a person who exchanges personal letters with you, rather than a journalist writing for a publication.

example.english: My correspondent in Canada writes to me often.
example.traditional: 我個筆友住喺加拿大，成日寫信畀我。
example.jyutping: ngo5 go3 bat1 jau5 zyu6 hai2 gaa1 naa4 daai6 sing4 jat6 se2 seon3 bei2 ngo5

rows.note: Use this for a thing that matches or corresponds to another thing, not for a person.

example.english: This symbol is the correspondent of another symbol and appears in the right-hand column.
example.traditional: 呢個符號係另一個符號嘅對應物，會列喺右邊嗰欄。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 fu4 hou6 hai6 ling6 jat1 go3 fu4 hou6 ge3 deoi3 jing3 mat6 wui5 lit6 hai2 jau6 bin1 go2 laan4
